entities.summary: Uru Uru Lake is a lake in the Oruro Department in Bolivia. It is fed by the Desaguadero River and the Jach'a Jawira. It is situated at an elevation of 3,686 m, its surface area is 214 km2. Uru Uru Lake is a lake in South America. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
